headline: Jeff Hafley, Dolphins hold off Jets, then revel in first win of season
summary: The Dolphins snapped a five-game losing streak to win their first game of the season, holding off a late New York Jets rally for a 28-25 victory.

headline: Chase's fiery halftime speech inspires Bengals to comeback win vs. Ravens
summary: Ja'Marr Chase unloaded on his Bengals teammates in a halftime speech that inspired Cincinnati to a comeback victory over the Ravens.

headline: 49ers 'took a step back' in first loss of season against Falcons
summary: On Sunday, after the Niners blew an 11-point lead and lost their first game of the season to the Atlanta Falcons, Warner had the distinct feeling that the outcome directly aligned with a lack of progress.

headline: Vikings rally to reach 6-0 even as offense hits historic lows for unbeaten team
summary: As his offense continued to grind Sunday at historically low levels for an undefeated team, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell had a simple message: "We're not far off."

headline: Singletary's 30-yard run in OT gives Giants 27-21 win over Texans
summary: — Two weeks ago, Cam Skattebo's fumble in overtime cost the New York Giants a chance at a win.

headline: Kendal Daniels seals Falcons' win with INT one week after trip to hospital
summary: Kendal Daniels had the game-sealing interception to help the Falcons beat the 49ers one week after he was immobilized by medical personnel.
